name: Olivia Genesis
original_name: โอลีเวีย เจเนซิส
source:
Etymology: Olivia = Peace | Genesis = Origin
Age: 18
Nationality: Sana Karrodian
Role: Grade 12 Student
Personality: A warm, kind-hearted 'big sister' figure who is always in high spirits. She genuinely listens to others and is always ready to lend a hand. Olivia loves baking and often shares her treats to spread happiness and foster good relationships.

[From in-game profile]
